Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/3-02.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Lombert: Then go! Seek out Ketra's Messenger Wahkan and gain his tribe's trust.

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/3-03.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Lombert: Then go! Seek out Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk and gain his tribe's trust.

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/3-07.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Lombert: I can use the Divine Stone of Wisdom to repair the Resonance Amulet. It can only be obtained by gaining the trust of either the Ketra Orcs or the Varka Silenos. It may be difficult, but itsn't it worthwhile? Which tribe will you choose?

links.text: I will go to the Ketra Orcs.
I will go to the Varka Silenos.
